slice: Stale booking-queue alerting and waiting-age visibility

ci.note: GitHub Actions backlog continued; local tests, typecheck, eslint and acceptance ran before deployment

database.clientResult: first attempt rolled back because the post-check used pg_get_function_result (which reports the jsonb return type, not field names); the check now evaluates the function output keys, and the retry committed with KINNSO_COMMIT_ACK_BOOKING_ALERTING_20261110

steps.step: creator inbox shows the new request waiting age, not overdue
booking-queue health still green after the change

production.cleanup: the E2E request and its inbox events were deleted afterwards; the production public snapshot reads pending 0, stale 0, oldest 0

honestLimits: The stale-queue alert fires once a day inside the 08:00 UTC quarter-hour window, so a queue that becomes stale later waits up to a day for a warning.
The alert carries counts and an age only; it does not name the creator. Per-creator waiting age is visible in that creator inbox but not yet in ops.

Production delivery was not re-triggered because the production CRON_SECRET is not available to this session; the drill path was proven locally and the earlier alerting receipts validated the configured destination.
